subject: [RFC PATCH 3/5] mm/page_alloc: convert any movable pageblock on a non-movable allocation

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of try_to_claim_block() in the Linux kernel's page allocation system. It ensures that a movable block is converted to match the type of non-movable allocation it serves, even if only half its pages are free or compatible. This change aims to prevent non-movable content from being stored in blocks typed as movable. The patch also introduces stricter rules for converting non-movable pageblocks to movable, requiring every page to be free or movable before a movable claim can take the block. Additionally, it ensures that blocks straddling zone edges are never claimed and modifies the behavior of zone_spans_pageblock() to test whether a block lies wholly inside its zone.
